endpoints.note: Broken invariant: no sealed_object. Custody has to be a claim about a NAMED body of ciphertext, so an entry that does not say which one cannot be checked at all. There is deliberately no default, because either default silently decides a custody question on the author's behalf.

platform_key.why: Private half of the intake sealed-box keypair, held only by the consumer, which is the sole reader of the metadata envelope.
